Answer: A
Reason: The second image demonstrates a distinct systemic feeding vessel with vascular flow (color Doppler) supplying the lung lesion, which is the pathognomonic radiological sign of pulmonary sequestration. While the first image shows cystic changes, the presence of a systemic arterial supply distinguishes this from other congenital lung malformations like CCAM/CPAM.
